name: Daily Standup
description: Generate a daily standup update by reading git activity, Jira board status, and PR state, then composing a concise status report.

sinceDays.description: Number of days to look back for activity (default: 1)

jiraProject.description: Jira project key to filter tasks (e.g. KOS)

parameters.command: git log --since='{{parameters.sinceDays}} days ago' --author=$(git config user.email) --oneline --no-merges && echo '---BRANCHES---' && git branch -a --sort=-committerdate | head -5 && echo '---DIFF-STAT---' && git diff --stat HEAD~5..HEAD 2>/dev/null || true

parameters.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND project = '{{parameters.jiraProject}}' AND status in ('In Progress', 'In Review', 'Done') AND updated >= -{{parameters.sinceDays}}d ORDER BY updated DESC

parameters.command: gh pr list --author @me --state open --json title,url,reviewDecision,isDraft --limit 5 2>/dev/null || echo 'No PRs found'

config.prompt_template:
You are composing a daily standup update from multiple data sources.

Git Activity:
{{read_git_log}}

Jira Tasks:
{{read_jira_board}}

Open Pull Requests:
{{read_open_prs}}

Format: {{parameters.format}}

Compose a standup update with three sections:

**Yesterday (Done):**
- Summarize completed work from git commits and Jira transitions to 'Done'
- Reference specific story IDs and PR titles

**Today (Planned):**
- List in-progress Jira items and what the next steps are
- Mention any PRs awaiting review

**Blockers:**
- Flag any PRs with requested changes or stalled reviews
- Note any Jira items that have been 'In Progress' for more than 2 days
- If no blockers, say 'None'

Keep it concise: 3-5 bullets per section max. Use the requested format.

options.label: Display in Terminal
options.description: Print the standup update to stdout for the user to copy

options.label: Copy to Clipboard
options.description: Copy the update to the system clipboard

options.label: Post to Slack
options.description: Send the update to the configured Slack channel
